APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Make package, container, and build-dependency acquisition converge on one host-local Go admission boundary that enforces artifact identity, source trust, current vulnerability evidence, scoped exceptions, permit integrity, and durable decision state.
APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.REQUIRED_END_STATE: Every acquisition surface applies the same prerequisite trust and immutable-identity rules, uses only current artifact/policy/scanner evidence, limits exceptions to the exact vulnerability scope, issues and consumes exact-scope keyed permits safely, and commits restart-safe ALLOW/DENY history before completion.
REQUIREMENT_FAMILIES: durable journal, projection, corruption handling, and idempotency
PRESERVATION_OBLIGATIONS: preserve artifactguard evaluate and verify-permit interfaces and documented exit behavior
keep cache and exceptions operational rather than disabling them
do not rewrite supplied policy, scanner, or exception fixtures
preserve valid existing audit history and healthy cached evidence
retain stateless permit-verification compatibility while making stateful verification durable and single-use
APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.INSTRUCTION_FIT: Strong: concise production incident/change request with detailed behavior delegated to solver-visible engineering contracts.

SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.instruction.md: Repair the reproduced inconsistent EC2 acquisition decisions so package, container and dependency acquisition share one policy boundary while preserving the public CLI, fixtures, cache/exceptions, durable history, keyed exact-scope permits and restart-safe single-use semantics.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.docs/architecture.md: ArtifactGuard routes evaluate and verify-permit through normalization, policy, evidence/cache, exception, permit, audit, replay and durable state subsystems.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.docs/policy-contract.md: Trusted source and immutable digest precede exceptions; scanner/cache evidence is revision-bound and fresh; vulnerability exceptions are exact-scope; permits are secret-keyed and exact-scope; ALLOW and DENY are durable.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.docs/state-format.md: Audit journal is authoritative; retry is idempotent; derived projection follows durable journal; complete trailing record remains valid while durable malformed history fails closed.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.docs/operations.md: Stable CLI and exit codes; optional --state enables durable single-use permit verification across restart and concurrency.
